scenarios.name: mapfail

scenarios.name: first-entry-send-map-invmpsz
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the SEND MAP ERASE of the menu fails INVMPSZ (planned, X71): nothing is sent and the program goes on to its abend routine

scenarios.name: mapfail-dataonly-send-map-tsioerr
scenarios.why: ENTER with no field modified: the second SEND MAP (DATAONLY ALARM, the invalid-value message) fails TSIOERR (planned, X71)

scenarios.name: receive-map-invmpsz

scenarios.name: first-entry-plain-return-invreq
scenarios.why: first entry: the closing RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') COMMAREA LENGTH(1) RESP fails INVREQ RESP2 4 (planned: IBM's TRANSID in a program associated with an APPC logical unit, register X71) -- the program goes on to its A010 abend routine

scenarios.name: invalid-action-plain-return-invreq
scenarios.why: action 9 (invalid): the closing RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') COMMAREA LENGTH(1) RESP fails INVREQ RESP2 4 (planned: IBM's TRANSID in a program associated with an APPC logical unit, register X71) -- the program goes on to its A010 abend routine

scenarios.name: pf12-send-text-tsioerr
scenarios.why: PF12: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG's SEND TEXT ERASE FREEKB (STM010) fails TSIOERR (planned, register X71): nothing is sent and the non-NORMAL arm takes the abend routine

notes: CBSA's main menu (BNKMENU, transaction OMEN, BMS map BNK1ME of mapset BNK1MAI: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1MAI.bms, @bms/BNK1MAI.cpy). Pseudo-conversational: a first task (EIBCALEN 0) sends the menu; a returning one (its 1-byte COMMAREA) acts on the AID -- PA keys do nothing, PF3 / PF12 end the session, CLEAR clears the screen, ENTER reads the action and either starts the chosen transaction with RETURN TRANSID(...) IMMEDIATE or re-sends the menu with a message, any other key re-sends it with 'Invalid key pressed.'. A planned condition (X71, #6271) drives the failure paths of RECEIVE MAP (INVMPSZ), SEND MAP (INVMPSZ, TSIOERR) and RETURN IMMEDIATE (INVREQ), and so ABEND-THIS-TASK and the ABNDPROC LINKs. Not reached: the failure branches of the plain RETURN TRANSID with RESP, SEND TEXT and SEND CONTROL -- no fault can be injected on those commands yet.
